subject: english
question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is **"Menipulate."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **"Manipulate."**
 
• The incorrect spelling in Option 2 has an** "e" between "m" and "n."**
 
• It means to handle or control something or someone in a skillful manner. (किसी को अपने पक्ष में प्रभावित कर लेना (कि वह वही करे या सोचे जो आप चाहते है))
 
 
• **Example:*** Throughout her career she has very successfully **manipulated**__ the media.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "Anticipate"** means to expect or predict something. (किसी चीज़ की आशा या भविष्यवाणी करना)
 
• **Option 3: "Calculate"** means to determine a mathematical answer or estimate. (गणना करना, हिसाब लगाना, परिकलन करना)
 
• **Option 4: "Instigate"** means to provoke or initiate an action. (उकसाना, भड़काना)
